description: Shared LOSAT job plan and nucleotide raw-key vectors. tests/test_losat_job_plan.py and tests/web/linear-sources.test.mjs run every case; Python gbdraw.comparisons.losat_jobs and Web planLosatSourceJobs/prepareLosatSourceBatches/buildLosatCachePayload must give the same jobs, batch FASTA hashes, searchContext, and raw keys. proteinCases are LOSATP plans (D7): Python losatp_job_specs and Web buildLosatJobSpecs give the same specs, prepare_losat_batches(protein=True) and prepareLosatSourceBatches({protein: true}) the same jobs, and build_protein_losat_cache_key (which the Web calls through its Python helper) the raw keys. Batch sides order records by record key (Web sequence uid); keys are ASCII so code-point and localeCompare order agree.
